audience: sales and service teams that keep people, organisations and tasks in Workbooks

useCases.title: Find a person or an organisation
useCases.text: Search CRM people or organisations with filters and paging. Open one record by its numeric id.

useCases.title: Review activity tasks
useCases.text: Search activity tasks with filters and paging. Use a field name from the record types list in a filter.

useCases.title: Review logged calls, emails and meetings
useCases.text: Search activities such as calls, emails and meetings, with filters and paging. Open a person record by id.

useCases.title: Learn custom fields before a search
useCases.text: List the record types and custom fields of the database. Then use a custom field in a search filter.
